name: Super Seeker
focus: Spatial awareness, quiet movement, coordinated rescue timing
summary: Players move across the play space attempting to return safely to base while avoiding Seekers. Tagged players power down until rescued by teammates.
overview: Players move across the play space attempting to return safely to base while avoiding Seekers who are trying to tag them. Tagged players power down until rescued by teammates, encouraging teamwork and smart movement decisions.
setup: Create a clearly defined base zone using cones at one end of the field. Select 1–2 players to begin as Seekers positioned between the base and the remaining players. All remaining players spread out across the play area away from the base before the round begins.
steps: Players begin scattered across the field away from the base.
Seekers patrol the space between players and the base.
Players attempt to move safely back to base without being tagged.
Tagged players power down where tagged and raise their hand.
Teammates may rescue powered-down players by touching hands or Zabers.
Rescued players receive a protected walk back to base.
Round ends when all players reach base or time expires.
Add an additional Seeker each round to increase difficulty.
powerDown: Tagged players immediately stop movement, power down, raise their hand, and remain in place until rescued by a teammate. After rescue, players receive a protected walk back to base.
rescue: Rescuers must touch hands or connect Zabers before escorting teammates safely back to base. Advanced variation: two rescuers required before escort begins.
levelUp: Level 1 — One Seeker patrols between players and base
Level 2 — Add additional Seekers each round
Level 3 — Require grouped movement toward base
Level 4 — Limit rescue escorts to walking speed only
Level 5 — Seekers patrol designated movement lanes inside the field
coachingObjective: Teach players to recognize safe movement windows, communicate quietly with teammates, and coordinate rescues while navigating shared space under pressure.
guardianConnection: Hero trains Super Moverz to recognize safe pathways through danger zones by keeping their heads up, moving at the right time, and helping teammates return safely to base.
quickReset: Select new Seekers, reposition players across the field, and restart immediately from scattered movement positions.
